claim.raw_value: declare, set aside or pay any dividend or other distribution, whether payable in cash, stock or other property, with respect to its capital stock, except for dividends by any wholly owned direct or indirect Subsidiary of the Company to the Company or any other wholly owned direct or indirect Subsidiary of the Company

attributes.why_unmapped: General interim-operations prohibition on declaring/paying dividends — a limb of the broader Section 4.1 operating covenant (clause (vi)(A)), not a coordination covenant or a one-time pre-closing special dividend.

claim.raw_value: provided that nothing contained herein shall prohibit dividends and distributions paid or made on a pro rata basis by direct or indirect Subsidiaries of the Company in the ordinary course consistent with past practice

attributes.why_unmapped: Carve-out permitting ordinary-course, pro rata subsidiary dividends — a recurring/ordinary-course dividend exception, not coordination language or a one-time special dividend.
